distribution: Huashuishan, Yingde, Guangdong; Baishita, Jingdezhen, Jiangxi; Mangshan, Hunan.
soldier: Head pale brown, paler behind, nasus brown, antennae, the upturned part of the pronotum and the abdominal tergites pale brown. Head and thorax almost hairless, the tip of the nasus with several long hairs, the abdominal tergites with rather many long and short soft hairs. In front view the transparent point at the tip of the nasus distinct, the head circular with length and width almost equal or width slightly greater than length. Nasus slender and tubular, slightly tapering forwards, deeply contracted where its base meets the antennal sockets, gourd-shaped, greatly raised behind the antennal sockets, the sides of the head evenly rounded, the posterior margin rather flat. In profile the tip of the nasus and the back of the head at about the same level, or the back of the head slightly higher, slightly concave between them. Mandibles blunt, without a spine. Antennae with 13 segments, the third twice as long as the second, the second short and almost equal to the fourth. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior half upright and upturned, meeting the posterior half at a right angle, the anterior notch indistinct, the posterior margin without a concavity. Spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi with four segments. The small soldier has the head and antennae yellow, the nasus yellowish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow; the head oval, narrow in front and broad behind, widest posteriorly, the posterior margin arcuate, the mandibles with a short small spine.
